issues.description: Field Book.title: the problem statement declares that Book.title is a String (problem_statement.md lines 16-18), but the solution implementation declares Book.title as an Int (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift line 26). The Client code in the solution constructs Book instances using String literals for title (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift lines 34-36), which will not compile against the Int declaration. This type mismatch makes the provided solution inconsistent with the specification and causes compilation failures for code that constructs Books with String titles.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book.title property type from Int to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift so it matches the problem statement and the Client usage. Update any documentation/comments for the Book struct accordingly and ensure all Book initializations use String titles.
